description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {1}, attaching it to Chishiro.
When Crown of Flames enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {2}.
Activate Crown of Flames's second ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
